name: git-cleanup
description: Cleans up after merged work, once it shipped: removing a branch needs git, the forge or the user to say it merged; removing it or filling in its issue waits for the pipeline holding it to pass; merged, clean work gets a follow-up to remove its worktree and branches.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token
gitlab_token.description: A read_api token, so merged work's cleanup and issue updates wait for its GitLab pipeline. Unset: GitLab work is not held back.
